### Common Pre-Drinking Ingredients

- **Electrolytes (sodium, potassium, magnesium):** Alcohol increases fluid and electrolyte loss, so replenishing them helps address dehydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1wJkoxShPtNBLXZ247VZ_lEftpqutTK6YFj4oyJDhOkY9pKOosbYcRW1Obkaq1ElxK5MgAtrQ0iyj4lIY6sq6IaiJHFndqnaSMt2M7ps4xndGM-psjNgTYojKaXbZBJUUcRMLGFsGKmocVulVKulOil6lAC9TFQPcNvjNxkpfH6wi81zNCMz_5UmRIIu9is)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/vbBa617LAuM)
- **N-acetylcysteine (NAC) and glutathione:** Used to support antioxidant levels and liver detoxification pathways.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF12Ntn3YeJfg1siP4eS-yMU2cvAiLwjO4WK5OBU7hZqhfO4p-pJ8sBTKosDmJoHHG7TwgWQumZdq9xevcGGN7V4pjERC76zjBa5gAUl3eZvtaIr-002KA23cg4cF3QQ8jOkkbIb9rUj0VcccWqBvpJYHTGH18fxCkt9VAcw)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/vbBa617LAuM)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/m9UVG95itgI)
- **Dihydromyricetin (DHM) and milk thistle:** Frequently included in pre-drinking blends for liver and recovery support, though human clinical proof for hangover prevention remains weak.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX_uMm1XiBV0bx2YCOZ4QVlNikceeUVDVA472wyeEEARunFVfHsjXNDFAu5iB0noSaalFV5N0DtW2KPplAjOXmCH2MgaPqn5oETSBnYukNfYqXnaoR5zH2N9GDbVd8FwfhzfhaNGLRR7YQEjzRnJ_3IYBG_cHVwHiu)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1wyHgm4PDJcuCAGvVwO5NV99FlhW4ODSiFbJPtsl4TSrOR67b5yRpz5UCDTEdNaLv5tRaluBIRXP3ql2uW6b9RydKuEMwdPFwGeI_ZLg8YUJOzSV2k0Xx5FsgXbexCKydEgInBaYrZ070E2mbtIn_ELzOmOwomJYpq51SrRKZ7v-9sivcw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF12Ntn3YeJfg1siP4eS-yMU2cvAiLwjO4WK5OBU7hZqhfO4p-pJ8sBTKosDmJoHHG7TwgWQumZdq9xevcGGN7V4pjERC76zjBa5gAUl3eZvtaIr-002KA23cg4cF3QQ8jOkkbIb9rUj0VcccWqBvpJYHTGH18fxCkt9VAcw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXAGBDUh80aFCQ8Dnq1P-qawjgkFn1E7JB2tddg5IX5-DciDblMlCjsUeVwf6MwcHWLeWSFnUT2WOT7VD4vf3djxp9JTJ95zchz-uNcTcs_X6HXLe3IzDBBiDQQMRuyJxzL-y6lA)

- **Targeted probiotics:** Products like [ZBiotics](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXX0PlHYHVaC0IIf9Yv-py848GoHAzqqjSPejmzr3jdWc7Y_Lgn_sr5IdMiCQNBq8a1AG9pX8dUFik3WWOzmTtKgf8CXCCaqIFS3w7PX_T-XtAYFN4Xx_aRUQhS65XH0A) use engineered *Bacillus subtilis* taken before drinking to break down acetaldehyde in the gut, while [Morning Recovery](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsAEBxCJF17CkWkucD6HTfqOAwqit2blNWK7u0MPkmxo_pKdy-zI6UjSYDxZrYts4hjWyBv2tEhDoC4mwKCVFLdNnhiq04fwZiBK8KsBo5OMgIenkg7ttSHYqPNHYp0Zj-pZgjOD6kUb_PJVh8BWQi5DVw5xzF5meb4gl6-R0MNEDLOkIHt1U3VdXkbUOHKSEqrW1j7qWkamV0J4oHZP-v3nOF_lFA0KAOpIU93J4jdqWsw) combines hydration and recovery ingredients for before or during drinking. As covered by [TIME](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1wyHgm4PDJcuCAGvVwO5NV99FlhW4ODSiFbJPtsl4TSrOR67b5yRpz5UCDTEdNaLv5tRaluBIRXP3ql2uW6b9RydKuEMwdPFwGeI_ZLg8YUJOzSV2k0Xx5FsgXbexCKydEgInBaYrZ070E2mbtIn_ELzOmOwomJYpq51SrRKZ7v-9sivcw) , controlled trials show limited overall proof that these products prevent hangovers, and [WIRED](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX_uMm1XiBV0bx2YCOZ4QVlNikceeUVDVA472wyeEEARunFVfHsjXNDFAu5iB0noSaalFV5N0DtW2KPplAjOXmCH2MgaPqn5oETSBnYukNfYqXnaoR5zH2N9GDbVd8FwfhzfhaNGLRR7YQEjzRnJ_3IYBG_cHVwHiu) notes that hydration, food, and moderation remain primary.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXX0PlHYHVaC0IIf9Yv-py848GoHAzqqjSPejmzr3jdWc7Y_Lgn_sr5IdMiCQNBq8a1AG9pX8dUFik3WWOzmTtKgf8CXCCaqIFS3w7PX_T-XtAYFN4Xx_aRUQhS65XH0A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXmjdd_8ggej3yXhP-C3VPkdAyhLKOZREbDWCXvakNn-tfY_x_WxtzFncl-TQ3H1_IwoepMAJzdS4rdIkmvunXeAkH3PeNdFZhQYJ-FB-Z33DhviKirDNo2m_ZQ_KOJN9ErfS7bnNGi9T6eg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1wyHgm4PDJcuCAGvVwO5NV99FlhW4ODSiFbJPtsl4TSrOR67b5yRpz5UCDTEdNaLv5tRaluBIRXP3ql2uW6b9RydKuEMwdPFwGeI_ZLg8YUJOzSV2k0Xx5FsgXbexCKydEgInBaYrZ070E2mbtIn_ELzOmOwomJYpq51SrRKZ7v-9sivcw)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXX_uMm1XiBV0bx2YCOZ4QVlNikceeUVDVA472wyeEEARunFVfHsjXNDFAu5iB0noSaalFV5N0DtW2KPplAjOXmCH2MgaPqn5oETSBnYukNfYqXnaoR5zH2N9GDbVd8FwfhzfhaNGLRR7YQEjzRnJ_3IYBG_cHVwHiu)

### Safety Notes

- **Avoid acetaminophen:** Do not take acetaminophen before or while drinking due to liver stress and toxicity risk.
- **Food and pacing matter most:** Eating a balanced meal beforehand and pacing drinks slow alcohol absorption more reliably than pills.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1wyHgm4PDJcuCAGvVwO5NV99FlhW4ODSiFbJPtsl4TSrOR67b5yRpz5UCDTEdNaLv5tRaluBIRXP3ql2uW6b9RydKuEMwdPFwGeI_ZLg8YUJOzSV2k0Xx5FsgXbexCKydEgInBaYrZ070E2mbtIn_ELzOmOwomJYpq51SrRKZ7v-9sivcw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF12Ntn3YeJfg1siP4eS-yMU2cvAiLwjO4WK5OBU7hZqhfO4p-pJ8sBTKosDmJoHHG7TwgWQumZdq9xevcGGN7V4pjERC76zjBa5gAUl3eZvtaIr-002KA23cg4cF3QQ8jOkkbIb9rUj0VcccWqBvpJYHTGH18fxCkt9VAcw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1wJkoxShPtNBLXZ247VZ_lEftpqutTK6YFj4oyJDhOkY9pKOosbYcRW1Obkaq1ElxK5MgAtrQ0iyj4lIY6sq6IaiJHFndqnaSMt2M7ps4xndGM-psjNgTYojKaXbZBJUUcRMLGFsGKmocVulVKulOil6lAC9TFQPcNvjNxkpfH6wi81zNCMz_5UmRIIu9is)
